comment: How validate.sh's test scripts are scheduled (tests/scripts/lib/run-suites.mjs --plan). 'alone' scripts run by themselves, with nothing else on the machine: their checks carry wall-clock limits that CPU contention breaks. 'shards' split the slow scripts across CI runners; the 'light' shard is every queued script no shard names, so the shards together always cover every script once. A name here that validate.sh does not queue fails the run.
